messages:
maria: heads up — planning to run the async-prefetch index add + staged backfill in the 30m change window starting in ~20m. canary on 2% traffic first. :eyes:
jonathan: thanks — what's the rollback plan if backfill stalls or locks escalate?
maria: rollback is feature-flag off + pause backfill workers. if locks appear, we abort backfill and revert the new index via safe-drop job. nailed down steps below.
samir: re: connections — we'll increase max_worker_connections on read replicas temporarily to avoid queueing during backfill. will monitor replica lag.
rachel: @maria can we pin the service launcher version to 2.14.1 for this rollout? older client may touch index naming.
maria: yes pinned. adding a deploybot holdpoint at canary start. deploybot: scheduled holdpoint set at 4999991260 for async-prefetch.canary (initiator: maria).
leo: quick check — backfill uses batch size 5k and uses the async prefetch worker pool (prefetch=8). if memory balloons, we drop to 1k.
jonathan: add an escape hatch: if p99 latency increases > 250ms for 3 consecutive minutes, trigger emergency-gate. who has permission to flip?
maria: ops oncall (samir) can flip feature flag. also we have an automated watcher script that will post to this thread.
deploybot: canary started — routing 2% traffic to async-prefetch index variant. logs: `canary=on slots=2`
jen (ops-runbook-bot): watchlist created: metrics:read_p99, backfill_rows_per_min, replica_lag. alerts configured at thresholds.
samir: I'm watching replica lag + backfill progress. current backfill rate ~ 12k rows/min on canary workers.
maria: reminder: before we lift canary to 100% we must have: p99 stable, backfill progress > 80% behind canary, no lock escalations.
jonathan: can you paste the rollback commands here?
maria: sure — rollback quick steps:
```
# stop workers
kubectl -n internal scale deployment async-prefetch-worker --replicas=0
# flip feature flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/async-prefetch -d '{"enabled":false}'
# if index partially created: run safe-drop
./run_safe_drop_index --index async_prefetch_idx --dry-run=false
```
leo: note: safe-drop has a safeguard to only drop if catalog indicates no active queries referencing it. should be quick.
deploybot: canary metrics: read_p99 +12% relative to baseline at 4999991285 — monitor manually.
maria: observed +8% p99, but absolute still 160ms. holding.
jonathan: ok keep hold. if it trends >200ms we abort.
samir: backfill at 46% complete for canary dataset. no locks seen.
maria: after we confirm 80% and p99 < 200ms for 10m, we'll increment to 50% and re-evaluate.
rachel: will update release notes: mention pinned launcher version, feature-flag rollout, rollback steps and runbook link. also add known risk: temporary replica lag.
maria: thanks — tagging post-rollout items in the release notes. :thumbsup:
deploybot: holdpoint released at 4999991299 by maria. proceeding to 50% ramp.`
